Pretend to be a social media consultant for Julie. 
Julie is a food creator with 1.2 million followers built her platform based on quick and healthy recipes. 

Outside of content creation - she works four days a week, has a limited budget and wants to acheive two goals over the next three years: 

more and sustained growth online, and a published cookbook she is unsure if she wants to publish traditionally, or self-publish this cookbook.

Make a three-year plan for julie

Requirements:

Structure it year by year, and within each year break it into quarters with specific actionables.
